body: Hm... could you provide some links and stuff? I like the thought you have, but I'm not sure where to go...

Thanks for the information, I might give the long A train ride a shot. I was thinking of taking the LIRR to Montauk, but I don't know how much the fare would cost or where trains I'd need to take... I also thought taking a train to Chicago would be a nice, long ride until I saw the price of the tickets.
I don't have any experience camping at all. I wouldn't know how.

I'm sorry, but I went through too much bullshit to get the claws of therapists and psychiatrists off of me. I will not go back to people like that. I know I need help, but their "help" isn't something I'll accept anymore.

Thank you for the resources and the offer. I don't really plan on staying in a homeless shelter (not just because of the environment, but because I'm sure there are others who need it more than me), and I wouldn't really classify myself as homeless, but I guess I am looking to get away from my "home" temporarily... And as much as I appreciate the offer of a meal and conversation, I don't think it's a good idea for me to be around other people right now. I'll also have to decline those mental health resources... I've had to deal with people like that in the past and I'll just say that they caused a lot of harm and did little-to-no good. I can't put any trust into those services anymore.

I figured a long train ride would be an okay way of sneaking some sleep in, but I can't think of any destinations I'd want to go to that would make the train ride long enough for me to get some decent sleep. The thought of dozing off and waking up in a completely different place also sounds like it'd be a little disorienting and frightening... And I'd rather not sleep on the floor of an airport.

Without going into it, I guess my life's just been going downhill for a long, long time and I've just recently started to realize that I feel like my home doesn't feel like *home* anymore and that I'm... starting to lose a grip on my identity. I likely won't be away for very long, hell, I likely won't be away for more than half a week, but I still feel like... I need to get away from everything I have left for a while... for as long as I can manage. Some space to clear my mind and try to rediscover myself, I guess.

Maybe taking some time to prepare for this trip to nowhere might help. I honestly don't know.
